reason: I already order once a month from an Instagram page I trust and it has mostly worked out. Paying 21,000 IQD in fees on a 30,000 item and waiting up to three weeks with a new company I've never heard of is not worth switching for.
objection: If the size or colour is a little off or I just don't like it, I'm stuck with it because there are no change-of-mind returns, and I don't know you yet. What counts as 'not as ordered' if the item looks different from the Taobao photo?
would_change_my_mind: A friend or sister ordering from them first and showing me it arrived right, plus being allowed to return or exchange if it doesn't fit.
